blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Pop girl group BINI member Mikha Lim has been placed under a 90-day preventive license suspension after a viral video showed her allegedly using her cellphone while driving. The Land Transportation Office (LTO) gave this information on Wednesday. The video showed Lim recording herself while behind the wheel before her cellphone fell. Instead of stopping in a safe place, she was seen reaching down to retrieve the device from underneath the vehicle. She was also seen holding the cellphone with both hands while driving, prompting the LTO to investigate the incident. READ: LTO revokes driver’s license of man for cellphone […]...
